experiment: Exploratory follow-up: nested chronological Ridge alpha tuning
selection_metric: mean absolute error in MW across inner forecast dates
tie_break: larger alpha for exactly equal inner MAE
inner_validation: Expanding one-month-ahead predictions from month 13 through the last observed month before each outer forecast
outer_evaluation: January 2020-June 2021; expanding one-month ahead; separate units
features: Previous three monthly average power values; scaler refitted inside every inner fold
comparisons: Previous month, trailing three-month mean, and original fixed-alpha=10 Ridge
interpretation: Protocol fixed before calculating tuned scores, but original scores and full-period EDA already seen. Not an untouched confirmatory test. No new alpha grid or objective chosen after viewing results.
